# Verbose output has a PR column, including in fast mode.
setup_workspace feat
exec grove add feat
exec git config branch.feat.grovePr 7

exec grove list -v --plain
stdout '^#7 +feat +\[feat\]'
stdout '^ +\* main +\[main\]'
! stdout '#0'

exec grove list --verbose --fast --plain
stdout '^#7 +feat +\[feat\]'
stdout '^ +\* main +\[main\]'
! stdout '#0'
